collinear_pruning.rationale: Year_Purchased_Clean is mathematically collinear (r=-1.0) with Years_Held; pruning prevents artificial 2x distortion of the ownership tenure dimension in Euclidean space.

optimal_k_justification: k=3 achieves the optimal macro-cluster cohesion (silhouette=0.3764) while yielding 3 clear, strategically distinct franchise investment archetypes. Although k=5 yields a silhouette of 0.4214, it fragments the dataset into micro-clusters (sizes 4, 4), destroying macroeconomic interpretability.

cluster_archetypes.1: Recent High-Capital Takeovers (Short Tenure ~6 yrs, High Purchase Price ~$2.2B, Private Equity/Billionaire Ownership)
cluster_archetypes.2: Hyper-Growth Outliers & Modern Powerhouses (10.8 yrs tenure, 173.8% 5-Yr Growth, Global Media Reach)
cluster_archetypes.3: Historic Blue-Chip Franchises (Long Tenure ~33.7 yrs, Historic Low Acquisition Cost ~$334M, Massive Compounded Value)
